tasks.title: Document the query dual-write convention in packages/web/AGENTS.md and run the whole-change verification
tasks.description: Add a short section to packages/web/AGENTS.md documenting the query dual-write convention entity api modules follow: every server read is an exported xxxQueryOptions factory owning the query key and fetch behavior plus a thin useXxx hook wrapping useQuery over it; layers above entities never hand-build query keys or issue raw fetches and reuse the factory for invalidation and prefetch; mutations pair a client function with an xxxMutationOptions factory and a thin useMutation hook; the unified session clients in entities/coder-session/api/client.ts are the reference implementation. Documentation only — no code retrofit. Then run the whole-change verification: the full gate suite, the production build, and the union word-boundary rg sweep over every symbol removed by T-001 through T-006.
